AGGREGATION_FOR_PASS_AMENDMENT: Would require a separate exact normative acceptance amendment; not proposed/applied here
DENIAL_OVERFLOW: Close publication gate and latch INCOMPLETE_AUDIT; still reject request before launch. No post-finalization grant budget reset.

EFFECTIVE_DENIAL_POLICY.AFTER_FINALIZATION: No new grant-scope publications or new attempt. Any separate host/global audit needs separate exact authority and budget, not implicitly created here. Final audit is interval-scoped.
EFFECTIVE_DENIAL_POLICY.COUNT_POLICY: No fixed numerical denial maximum inferred from one launch; future entry subject must derive finite record/witness admissions from allotted bytes and exact schema/controller bounds. Failure to derive blocks activation.
EFFECTIVE_DENIAL_POLICY.DOMAIN: All duplicate-denial evidence attributable to the grant and observed within its exact authorized collection interval is within same65536 publication allocation
EFFECTIVE_DENIAL_POLICY.FURTHER_REQUESTS: Continue fail-closed rejection; no new per-request publications after audit gate closes. Subsequent unrecorded requests cannot be represented as fully audited.
EFFECTIVE_DENIAL_POLICY.OVERFLOW_RULE: When a denial cannot be recorded with its required witness under allocated bytes/cardinality, reject request before any launch and latch INCOMPLETE_AUDIT. Publish only the pre-reserved bounded overflow/final-outcome slot, never an unlimited per-request log.
EFFECTIVE_DENIAL_POLICY.POLICY: Reject duplicate/partial/conflicting grant anchors without launching. Denial publication uses bounded full records with required witnesses. A bounded summary may report overflow or missing detailed denial witnesses only with INCOMPLETE_AUDIT; it does not count as complete individual causal replay and cannot make qualification PASS under this rule.

GAP: Exact denial byte-admission and operation/FD/stop/query/capture/writer plan needed. One authorized attempt and uint64 summary counters are not an event bound.
PROPOSED_AGGREGATION: Bounded117 overflow summary includes canonical grant reference, first denial witness/reason, uint64 counters with explicit saturation/unknown, interval and no-retry. Count saturation prevents memory/string growth, but does not prove complete individual-denial audit. Only INCOMPLETE_AUDIT is permitted for missing detail under effective115.
